fusions.name: Covering Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then drives the tines in, dealing 13 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile's End Sweep
fusions.desc: Swings the haft in a full circle, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Walking Staff
fusions.desc: Leans your weight on the haft: your stamina recovery rises 40% for 20 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Swept Gravel Path
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 10%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
